Context: 4. Contributory Provident Fund

5. Advances and Withdrawals.3 months' pay or half the amount of subscription and interest thereon at credit, whichever is less, in the case of normal advance/ withdrawal. No such limit, in the case of special advance/ withdrawal. Recovery in not more than 24 equal monthly instalments if the advance is within 3 months' pay and 36 instalments, if it exceeds 3 months' pay. - Rules 13, 14, 16 to 19.
6. All other matters.No difference except that the corresponding CPF Rules have to be referred to.
